parts.name: Translation Panel 1
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the sliding glass panels of the window, made primarily of glass with a supporting aluminum or PVC frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open or close by sliding horizontally, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the horizontal track within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel 2
parts.Basic_description: This is the second sliding glass panel of the window, also made of glass with a supporting frame.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first panel to open or close the window, allowing adjustable airflow.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in the opposite direction of the first panel along the same track.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the window, made of aluminum, providing structural support for the sliding panels.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the sliding panels in place, ensuring smooth movement and sealing when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support structure for the moving panels.
